data.content: Artificial Intelligence is a field of computer science that focuses on creating systems capable of performing tasks that require human intelligence.
Machine Learning is a subset of AI that allows computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed.

explanation: An object remains at rest or in uniform motion unless acted upon by a net external force.
visualization_hint: Show a block moving at constant velocity until an external force is applied.

explanation: The acceleration of an object is directly proportional to the net force acting on it and inversely proportional to its mass.
visualization_hint: Animate two blocks with different masses accelerating under the same force.

explanation: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.
visualization_hint: Show two objects pushing on each other with opposite forces (e.g., a ball hitting a wall).

explanation: Work is done when a force causes displacement in the direction of the force.
visualization_hint: Animate an object being pushed along a surface with arrows showing force and displacement.

explanation: The energy possessed by an object due to its motion.
visualization_hint: Show a rolling ball speeding up, with increasing glow to represent rising kinetic energy.

explanation: The stored energy of an object due to its position in a gravitational field.
visualization_hint: Animate a block lifted upward; label energy increasing with height.

explanation: Energy cannot be created or destroyed; it can only change from one form to another.
visualization_hint: Show a pendulum converting potential energy to kinetic energy and back.

explanation: Momentum is the product of mass and velocity and represents the quantity of motion.
visualization_hint: Show two carts colliding and arrows showing momentum transfer.

explanation: Impulse is the change in momentum of an object when a force acts over a time interval.
visualization_hint: Animate a bat hitting a ball and display force-time graph.

explanation: The force directed toward the center of a circular path that keeps an object moving in a circle.
visualization_hint: Show a ball on a string rotating in a circle with inward-pointing force arrows.

explanation: Friction is the resistive force that opposes motion between surfaces in contact.
visualization_hint: Show a block sliding on different surfaces, slowing down due to friction.

formula: τ = r × F = r * F * sin(θ)
explanation: Torque measures the rotational effect of a force applied at a distance from the axis of rotation.
visualization_hint: Animate a wrench turning a bolt with varying lever arm lengths.

explanation: Gravity is the force that attracts two bodies toward each other.
visualization_hint: Show two masses with arrows indicating attraction.
